text: In pgTAP, assert the affected-row count (or resulting state) of every write under RLS; lives_ok alone passes when the policy silently filters every row.

source.finding: lives_ok on UPDATE under RLS stayed green with policies loosened

text: Give every restrictive RLS policy a negative test: an unauthorized role attempts the read or write and the test asserts zero rows or the expected error.

source.finding: admin-only policies had no negative test

text: Before reporting SQL/RLS work, loosen each policy, check and guard (rolled-back transaction or temporary edit), confirm a test goes red, and report a mutation -> failing test table.

source.finding: three loosened policies left the suite green

text: Test limits at the exact boundary (n-1, n, n+1) and time windows at both edges, so a >= vs > swap or a removed window fails a test.

source.finding: boundary and window mutations survived the suite

text: Check every RPC argument for NULL explicitly and test each one with NULL; comparisons with NULL yield NULL, skip if-guards and can act as 'all' or a destructive default.

source.finding: NULL argument accepted as a destructive command

text: Triggers declared 'update of col' fire even when the value is unchanged; add 'when (old.col is distinct from new.col)' and test an update to the same value.

source.finding: update-of trigger fired without a value change

text: Change all columns of a multi-column state transition in a single UPDATE; separate UPDATEs expose an intermediate state that checks and triggers reject or mishandle.

source.finding: check constraint depended on a two-column transition

text: Every limit or invariant check (per-user caps, last admin) takes a lock; namespace advisory-lock keys and follow one documented global lock order to avoid deadlocks.

source.finding: per-user limit without lock; set_member_permissions vs set_member_role lock order

text: Revoke EXECUTE on every new function from public, anon and authenticated (and service_role for internal helpers); Supabase grants it by default. Grant back only what the API calls.

source.finding: default EXECUTE to authenticated and PUBLIC

text: Keep a pgTAP sweep of effective privileges: has_function_privilege for anon, authenticated and public, table/sequence privileges incl. relkind S and MAINTAIN, allowlisted by exact signature.

source.finding: name-based allowlist, sequences and MAINTAIN not swept

text: Every security definer function sets search_path = '', schema-qualifies every object and reads the caller via (select auth.uid()).
In multi-tenant tables reference parents with composite FKs (household_id, x_id) so a row cannot point at another tenant's row; use 'on delete set null (x_id)' to keep the tenant column.
Order audit rows with clock_timestamp(), not now(); now() is the transaction start, so several events written in one transaction tie.

source.finding: audit events in one transaction had identical timestamps

text: Protect append-only audit tables from UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE and TRIGGER for every role, service_role included, and test that each is refused.

source.finding: service_role kept UPDATE/TRIGGER on the audit table

text: pgTAP is()/results_eq() cannot wrap a data-modifying WITH; run the write at top level (or in a helper returning row_count) and assert its result afterwards.
